compute_cler: compute the classification error rate from model probabilities and ground truth labels for neuromotor gesture recognition
detect_gesture_events: detect discrete gesture events from model output probabilities using a configurable threshold and debounce time
debounce_events: apply debouncing to a list of gesture events to filter out rapid consecutive activations
compute_confusion_matrix: compute a confusion matrix by aligning detected gesture events with ground truth labels using Needleman-Wunsch
map_gestures_to_probabilities: map raw model output probability arrays to a dictionary keyed by gesture type names
